naslov: Kings face the Magic on 3-game skid
tekst:
Orlando Magic (2-7, 12th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Sacramento Kings (1-9, 14th in the Western Conference)
              Sacramento, California; Tuesday, 10 p.m. EST
              BOTTOM LINE: Sacramento comes into the matchup against Orlando as losers of three games in a row.
              Sacramento went 22-60 overall a season ago while going 15-26 at home. The Kings averaged 8.0 steals, 4.5 blocks and 13.7 turnovers per game last season.
              Orlando went 45-37 overall with a 19-21 record on the road a season ago. The Magic allowed opponents to score 115.1 points per game and shoot 47.6% from the field last season.
              INJURIES: Kings: Ben Simmons: out for season (achilles), Domantas Sabonis: out (knee), Maxime Raynaud: out (knee).
              Magic: Paolo Banchero: out (ankle), Jonathan Isaac: out (knee), Desmond Bane: day to day (illness), Izaiyah Nelson: out (ankle), Noah Penda: out (hamstring), Jalen Suggs: out (knee).
